page_title: LEV 5-1 DAR | Bayer Leverkusen v Darmstadt 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Sven Jablonski is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' The attendance is 29653.
83' 5 - 1 Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
82' Bayer Leverkusen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) for his blatant foul.
80' Granit Xhaka will be replaced by Noah Mbamba (Bayer Leverkusen).
80' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Florian Wirtz.
77' The resulting corner, taken by Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt), comes to nothing.
77' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
73' A long cross into the box finds Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) unmarked, but his header from the edge of the six-yard box is wild and goes miles wide of the left post.
72' It is time for a substitution. Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is on for Jeremie Frimpong.
72' Here's the change. Jonathan Tah leaves the pitch and Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.
69' It will be a substitution. Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is ready to enter the pitch as Marvin Mehlem walks off.
68' Problems for Torsten Lieberknecht as Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Matej Maglica replaces him.
67' 4 - 1 Goal! Victor Boniface slips it to Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 4:1.
67' Looks like Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
65' That will be all from Exequiel Palacios who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen).
64' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post.
61' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Florian Wirtz tees up Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Marcel Schuhen.
58' Here is a change. Thomas Poppler Isherwood is going off and Torsten Lieberknecht gives the last tactical orders to Filip Stojilkovic (Darmstadt).
58' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) for Oscar Vilhelmsson.

56' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Sven Jablonski with no other option than to blow for a foul.
53' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sven Jablonski had an easy-decision to make.
49' 2 - 1 Goal! Jeremie Frimpong plays it to Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Marcel Schuhen. 2:1.
48' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) probably handled the ball.
47' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
43' A snap shot by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Marcel Schuhen flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
41' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) makes a rough challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
35' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayer Leverkusen.

34' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Marcel Schuhen thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
31' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) has tested the patience of referee Sven Jablonski and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
29' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
26' Torsten Lieberknecht is forced to make a change. Fabian Nurnberger is unable to continue due to injury, Emir Karic (Darmstadt) comes on.
25' 1 - 1 GOAL 1:1! The resulting free kick is headed powerfully goalwards by Christoph Klarer and Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) glances a header from close range into the back of the net.
24' The game is interrupted. Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
24' Dangerous play by Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen). Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the ball inside the box, sees the goalkeeper off his line and lifts the ball over him and into the back of the net. 1:0.
20' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

19' That didn't go as planned! Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Marcel Schuhen, who easily kept it out.
18' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

16' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
15' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
13' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
12' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.

9' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
8' Sven Jablonski blows the whistle, Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) is penalised for a foul.
7' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
6' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a through ball but overhits it.
4' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
3' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
2' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The match has just started.
Darmstadt will kick the game off.
Sven Jablonski will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
